messages.en:
{07 15 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}it's you!{01 00 00 14 00} Remember how
the other day we planned
for me to come over?
And then you totally stood
me up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 01 00} Why'd
you do that to me?!
{07 00 00}I've{01 00 00 05 00} never been so
humiliated!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 05 00}Not in my
entire life! {03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}see oled sina!{01 00 00 14 00} Mäletad,
kuidas me üleeile kokku
leppisime, et ma tulen
külla? Ja siis sa lasid mul
tühja oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{01 01 00}
Miks sa mulle nii tegid?!
{07 00 00}Ma pole{01 00 00 05 00} kunagi nii
alandatud olnud!{01 00 00 05 00} {07 05 00}Mitte
kogu oma elus! {03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I{01 00 00 05 00} went to your place like we
planned the other day, 
but {07 1b 00}you stood me up!
{07 05 00}Unforgivable!{01 00 00 14 00} If that ever
happens again,{01 00 00 0a 00} you don't
want to know what'll happen!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma{01 00 00 05 00} läksin sinu juurde, nagu
me kokku leppisime,
aga {07 1b 00}sa lasid mul tühja
oodata! {07 05 00}Andestamatu!{01 00 00 14 00} Kui
see veel kord juhtub,{01 00 00 0a 00} sa ei
taha teada, mis saab!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} remember how we made
plans for me to come over?{01 01 00}
Oh, NOW you remember!
{07 01 00}Then why did you stand me
up, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? It was
awful! I was all alone!
{07 05 00}You know{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}you're gonna lose
all your friends if you keep
that up!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} mäletad, kuidas me
leppisime kokku, et ma
tulen?{01 01 00} Oi, NÜÜD sa mäletad!
{07 01 00}Miks sa siis lasid mul
tühja oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? See
oli kohutav! Ma olin päris
üksi! {07 05 00}Tead{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}sa kaotad kõik
oma sõbrad, kui sa nii
jätkad!{03 02 00 01}
